title: Stale-answer alerts
body: Change a policy page and Reply now tells you which answers relied on the old version — with the conversations they went out in, so you can follow up before a customer does.

title: WhatsApp Business, properly
body: Media, templates, and delivery receipts all work now, and a customer's history follows them between WhatsApp and email instead of starting over.

title: Confidence thresholds per queue
body: Billing can require near-certainty before Reply answers on its own while shipping stays permissive. Set the bar per queue rather than per workspace.

title: Draft handovers
body: Escalated conversations now arrive with a suggested reply attached. Agents accept, edit, or bin it — accepted drafts are marked in reporting so you can see what it is worth.

title: Faster first token
body: Answers begin streaming in under 400ms at the median, down from 1.3 seconds. Long answers finish about twice as fast as they did in March.

title: Source citations everywhere
body: Every answer now shows the documents behind it, in the inbox and in the customer-facing transcript. Retire a source and dependent answers are re-checked immediately.
